title: Every simulator boot on the Mac goes through one machine-wide lock
why: A home iOS lane reported (Nov 1 19:02 CST, relayed by the owner) that sim-test (the shared simulator tool) takes no machine-wide lock, and a lane that boots with simctl or the Simulator panel skips sim-test entirely. Two sessions can then boot and fight over simulators.
note: Today bin/sim-test says it takes no lock and waits for no load; the guard counts boots toward its cap (step c165, done) but holds no lock. Fix: sim-test takes one lock per Mac before it boots, and the guard refuses a direct simctl boot (or a Simulator open) that bypasses sim-test, pointing at sim-test. Red first: a second sim-test boot while one holds the lock waits or refuses; a raw simctl boot is refused. Guard basis: named incident (home crash loop, Nov 1). The lane says it reported this earlier as gap 6; no step or inbox entry for it was found here, so this is its first home. Port: yes, sim-test and the guard run on every Mac. Ready. Lane session_013NEJL3rd4F6NYG6NJVzL63 (with sim-crash-loop-stop), started Nov 1 19:04 CST.
